summary: Electrovaya Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the commencement of Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) for its automated lithium-ion cell assembly and formation equipment at the equipment manufacturer's site. Approximately 10 Electrovaya staff will validate equipment using production-grade materials, including proprietary ceramic separators. FAT is expected to complete by early October 2026, after which equipment ships to the Jamestown, New York facility for installation and commissioning. This is an operational milestone update, not a special situation. No financial terms, stake changes, or strategic actions are disclosed. Routine progress report on manufacturing capacity expansion; no deal terms or arbitrage angle.
